info.description:
Convert anything to LLM-ready Markdown.

Create a job with `POST /v1/convert` (multipart upload or JSON URL), follow it with `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/events` (SSE) or by polling `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}`, then fetch `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/result`. The job id is the capability; jobs created with an API key also require that key. Every response carries `X-Request-Id`; every error uses the schema below.

## Error codes

| code | status | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_request` | 400 | Malformed body, unknown option, or invalid profile override. |
| `turnstile_required` | 401 | A Turnstile token is required for URL jobs on this instance. |
| `turnstile_failed` | 403 | The Turnstile token was rejected. |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | Missing or unknown API key, or bad fetch-node secret. |
| `forbidden` | 403 | The key or node may not do this (for example residential fetches). |
| `not_found` | 404 | Unknown job, attachment, or route. |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | Wrong HTTP method. |
| `job_not_ready` | 409 | The job has not reached the state this call needs. |
| `input_too_large` | 413 | Upload or fetched body over the caller's cap. |
| `unsupported_media_type` | 415 | Executable or unsupported input. |
| `url_blocked` | 422 | The URL (or a URL a converter asked for) failed the SSRF guard. |
| `platform_disabled` | 422 | The site is disabled by this instance's platform policy. |
| `experimental_disabled` | 422 | Only an experimental converter handles this input and experimental converters are off. |
| `fetch_depth_exceeded` | 422 | A converter asked for more nested fetches than intomd.inputs.MAX_FETCH_DEPTH allows. |
| `result_too_large` | 422 | The converter's result exceeded INTOMD_MAX_RESULT_BYTES. |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many requests, jobs, or concurrent jobs; see Retry-After. |
| `conversion_failed` | 500 | Every converter in the chain failed. |
| `internal_error` | 500 | Unexpected server error (logged with the request id). |
| `not_implemented` | 501 | The format exists in the contract but is not built yet (docx). |
| `fetch_failed` | 502 | The URL could not be fetched. |
| `queue_unavailable` | 503 | The queue is down or the instance is at its active-job cap. |
| `timeout` | 504 | The conversion exceeded its time limit. |
info.title: intomd API

post.description: Send `multipart/form-data` with a `file` part (and an optional `options` JSON part), or JSON with a `url`. Returns 202 with the job envelope, or 200 when an identical finished job is reused. URL inputs from anonymous callers need a Turnstile token when the instance requires one. With `wait=N` the call blocks up to N seconds (max 60) and returns the rendered result directly if the job finishes in time.
